name: Idebenone
metabolism: Human metabolism has not yet been verified for this entry. Responsible enzymes, metabolites and elimination routes are not specified. This is a documentation gap, not evidence that the substance is not metabolized; do not infer a pathway from related compounds.
summary: Idebenone is a quinone-family compound developed as a medication for cognitive disorders and neuromuscular diseases. It is approved in the European Union for Leber's hereditary optic neuropathy and is also marketed as a synthetic coenzyme Q10 analogue.
